changelog.summary: Adds a chat-led refund decision and finance reconciliation with exact amount, provider receipt and ledger-state validation.

title: Refund Request to Reconciled Outcome
description: Review a SaaS customer refund against the exact payment and policy, then verify its provider and finance outcome without an implicit money action.
setup_prompt: Use Refund Request to Reconciled Outcome as a proposal. Inspect compatible Billing Operations Coordinator and Revenue & Close Analyst Crews, the Refund Review pack, exact customer request, payment, prior refunds, policy and current ledger. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, validated artifacts, separate action approval, and one manual case. Show the concrete plan before Builder applies it. Selection neither issues a refund nor sends a message, posts a ledger entry, or enables recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Exact customer refund request and original payment or charge ID
Entity, provider account and mode, customer, currency and observation time
Original, succeeded and pending refund amounts; requested amount; policy and approver
Authorized ledger, accounting export or settlement source
Billing reviewer, finance owner and refund action authority
Manual-only or reviewed request event and cadence

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew
recommended_tools.purpose: Create only reviewed missing Crew identities with stable keys

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment
recommended_tools.purpose: Pass a bounded validated decision to the finance Crew

recommended_tools.name: Stripe or another processor, or export
recommended_tools.purpose: Read current payment, prior refunds, status and provider receipts

recommended_tools.name: Accounting ledger or export
recommended_tools.purpose: Verify finance treatment and settlement state

recommended_tools.name: Approved provider refund route
recommended_tools.purpose: Issue an exact separately approved refund and retain the provider receipt

pulse_focus.label: Refund decision and observed outcome
focus_areas: Whether requests are decided against the exact current payment and remaining amount
Whether provider-processed refunds are reconciled without duplicate writes or unsupported closure
review_when: A refund request is added or changed, provider status changes, or a reconciliation remains open past owner policy

outputs: Reviewed two-Crew roster and source map
Validated refund-decision/v1 with exact arithmetic and approval state
Validated refund-reconciliation/v1 with provider and ledger observations
Manual request result, action ledger and activation choice
